fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (36.723019,-76.619984) landed in a residential subdivision ~3.5 km west of the real plant. Corrected via EPA FRS registry 110001135762 and the 245 Culloden St address to the historic Planters/Mr. Peanut factory complex in downtown Suffolk; locked center 36.72320,-76.58270.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is fully enclosed by chain-link fence with privacy slats (StreetView 2022-2023). A chain-link gate spans the truck drive at the north end of the internal yard. No barrier arm but a controlled fenced gate = truckGate true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the truck gate in satellite or StreetView. The blue-roofed pavilion on Culloden St is the office/visitor entrance (Mr. Peanut statue), not a truck checkpoint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated truck entry with no guard shack -> remote check-in (kiosk/call-box) implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~38 dock doors across the two building faces lining the internal drive yard plus the SW dock apron; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 leased XTRA trailers parked in the internal yard and SW lot without tractors.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Old urban factory in downtown Suffolk VA, surrounded on all sides by dense residential streets; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal drive yard between buildings is long enough to stack 3+ trucks before docks.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single connected industrial complex (4 attached/adjacent buildings); treated as one facility, not a multi-campus -> multipleFacilities false.
